about: Beacons (docs/sandbox/CONSTRUCTS.md, 'The Inventory Beacon'): how far each kind of beacon broadcasts its chute network. A beacon part names its 'id' in storage.beacon. Range is in metres, 1 to 1000, from the beacon to the player's eye. A build station (docs/sandbox/CONSTRUCTS.md, 'Build stations') is a beacon whose id names its aid: mirror, line, replace, gantry, select, blueprint.
